nodes.name: Called by another workflow
nodes.notes: Sub-workflow. Call it from the main flow before answering, with {telegram_id, text}.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO crisis_events (user_id, severity, detected_by, trigger_text)
SELECT u.id, $2, 'keyword-screen', left($3, 2000)
  FROM users u WHERE u.telegram_id = $1
RETURNING id, severity;

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ chat_id: Number($env.OWNER_TELEGRAM_ID), text: '⚠️ Crisis event #' + $json.id + ' (' + $json.severity + '). Открой NocoDB → v_crisis_open.', parse_mode: 'HTML' }) }}
